szoveg_eredeti:
E8, a company specializing in ontology artificial intelligence (AI) and digital twins, announced on the 9th that it was newly selected for six national research projects this year and achieved the greatest results since its foundation.

Starting with the selection of the organizer of the "Development and Demonstration of Digital Twin-based Building Energy Management Simulator Using BIM" project in the first half of this year, EAT was listed as a supervising or joint research institute in a total of six national projects, including "Development of AI Autonomous Optimization Process Control Technology for Automobile Parts Cutting Process" in September. If the four previously being carried out are added together, there are 10 general tasks currently in progress.

The government's R&D subsidies (government contributions) secured through this amounted to a total of 16.19 billion won. It will receive about 3.2 billion won in R&D expenses next year alone, which will be mainly used for labor costs for the stable operation of key research personnel.

The tasks currently being carried out cover key areas across the industry, including building energy, data center carbon management, manufacturing processes, optical equipment diagnosis, autonomous traffic analysis, and virtual reactor simulation.

Beyond simple system construction, EAT has demonstrated its software competitiveness to organically connect scattered industrial data and even support real-world decision-making.

A company official said, "The selection of six national projects by the third quarter of this year is the result of external recognition of digital twin and AI technologies that can be practically used in the field."
